output.explanation:
The central tree preserves the 3+1 overview while shrinking the seed from 132 lines and 9,557 characters to 91 lines and 6,504 characters: reductions of 31.1% and 31.9%. Six peripherals branch from specific concept lines and mix modular structure [M], calls [C], ownership [O], and data dependency [D] where useful. Data dependency remains a cross-cutting account of required inputs.

Source-grounded refinements: mappingDocumentController.ts, commitEditorGesture/applyOperations, establishes that empty gestures bypass the operation loop, ordinary batches allow 100 operations, and editor gestures allow 10,000. Version checking applies to particular entry points, not every facade mutation. canvasTransfer.ts explicitly assigns publication to a workspace transaction in its contract comment, but supplies only preparation; the publisher implementation is unavailable. Its move branch converts every source edge to a jump, including edges unrelated to selected placements. canvasHistory.ts, documentFromHistory, clones the read model and freezes diagram payloads, so the seed's shared-revision shorthand is represented as a dependency rather than a runtime object-sharing claim.

Additional source detail includes dirty comparisons that ignore viewport/selection, generation publication guards, revision boundaries, persistence change sequences, and fork retaining the archive despite clearing navigation stacks (canvasHistory.ts); saved-view ancestry validation (canvasView.ts); runtime context isolation (canvasHistoryService.ts); strict new endpoints versus tolerated stale endpoints (diagramConnection.ts); and coordinate limits, horizontal gap behavior, and hit testing (lineGrid.ts).

Evidence is limited to the supplied point, seven pinned source texts, and seed. Imported helper internals and workspace publication are not inferred. Checkpoint publication ordering does not establish rollback of every external helper side effect. All seven trees use printable ASCII and LF, have valid concept-line connections, and occupy nonoverlapping measured rectangles with gaps.

|   |-- Composition and connection rules
|   |   |-- LineGrid: measurement, box edits, layout, composition and hit testing

|   |   `-- Connection rules depend on placements and diagram content nodes
|   `-- Transfer boundary: prepare states, check boundaries, prepare navigation

|   |-- applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations); transact delegates here
|   |   |-- Settle pending live gesture; clear temporary node correspondence
|   |   `-- applyOperations

|   |       |-- Clone document/view; execute operations in array order

|   |       |   |-- Edit revisions, placements, links, presentation and context
|   |       |   `-- Check operation-specific IDs, revisions, hashes and anchors

|   |           |-- Normalize diagram views and resolve floating geometry
|   |           |-- historyService.append -> CanvasHistory.append
|   |           |   |-- Validate document/revisions; build bindings and anchors
|   |           |   `-- Publish checkpoint; push old head to past; clear future
|   |           `-- Replace snapshot, advance version, notify; return nodes/version
|   |-- commitEditorGesture(operations, canvas)
|   |   |-- Shared operation path uses supplied view; grid moves settle after loop

|   |-- undo(redo)

|   |   |-- Headless -> service.navigate -> history.navigate -> restore state

|   `-- prepareTransfer -> prepareCanvasTransfer
|       |-- Validate distinct canvases and unique selected diagram placements

|-- [O] Ownership: runtime state, revision retention and branch lifetimes
|   |-- Controller owns snapshot, listeners, cache and gesture bookkeeping
|   |   |-- At most one attached editor driver; returned callback detaches it
|   |   `-- Transient selection/layout updates can avoid history/version changes
|   |-- DefaultCanvasHistoryService owns histories through a WeakMap
|   |   |-- Frozen object handles isolate viewers with the same persisted context ID
|   |   `-- Unreferenced handles permit collection of their history association
|   |-- CanvasHistory owns checkpoint archive, revision table and navigation
|   |   |-- Checkpoint = composition + exact diagram bindings + personal view

|   |   |-- fork creates a new context/baseline and empty navigation stacks

|   `-- Placement identity and content identity have separate lifetimes

    |-- Valid connection endpoint

Command staging and publication [C/O/D]
|-- Entry points have different guards
|   |-- applyUpdate/transact: settle driver, then check expectedVersion
|   |-- Ordinary batches: 1..100 operations
|   |-- Editor gestures: up to 10000 operations with supplied canvas view
|   |   `-- Empty gesture bypasses applyOperations and may record view changes
|   `-- commitDocument and select have no caller expectedVersion parameter
|-- Staging uses a cloned document/view
|   |-- prepareDiagramEdit reads the latest staged content revision
|   |-- trackNodes composes node correspondence across successive edits
|   |-- patchDiagram also rebases links, collapsed-node IDs and section lines
|   |-- diagram-context-set checks diagram ID, revision and source fingerprint
|   `-- Grid moves: ordinary commands layout immediately; gestures defer layout
|-- Cleanup precedes updateSnapshot
|   |-- Drop contexts without placements and alternatives without owners
|   `-- Project scene and repair missing activeBoxId
|-- updateSnapshot separates recording from version advancement
|   |-- Remove deleted selection members; captured regions can remain stale
|   |-- Normalize views, resolve floating geometry, then append if recording
|   |-- Geometry changes clear cached endpoint measurements
|   `-- Replace snapshot and notify listeners after append
`-- Runtime-only paths
    |-- updateCanvas(record=false): no checkpoint or version increment
    |-- nodes(): cache by snapshot identity; return a structured clone
    `-- applyUpdate clears correspondence in finally, including on error

Checkpoint storage and reconstruction [O/D/C]
|-- Canonical checkpoint
|   |-- Composition root, edges and metadata; no embedded scene.contents
|   |-- diagramBindings: contentId -> exact issued revision ID
|   |-- Personal view, nodeOrigins and optional unresolvedAnchors
|   `-- Alternatives, reviews and selections add revision dependencies
|-- append validates before publishing the checkpoint
|   |-- Assert issued diagrams; collect missing revisions and ancestry
|   |-- Initial baseline may pin omitted parents in revisionBoundary
|   |-- Encode current content-node IDs as logical revision.nodeRefs
|   `-- Add records, move head, push past and clear future navigation
|-- documentFromHistory reconstructs a read model
|   |-- Bound revision.diagram payloads + stored root -> scene
|   |-- Logical node reference -> bound revision's current contentNodeId
|   |-- unresolvedAnchors override decoding with the original stale endpoint
|   `-- Clone result and deep-freeze its diagram payloads
|-- Retention and transport differ from navigation
|   |-- fork copies the archive, creates a baseline and clears past/future
|   |-- export(true): head + direct dependencies; omit undo ancestry
|   |   `-- Any saved or recording CanvasView forces full export instead
|   `-- adopt keeps the revision-table object used by the internal resolver
`-- persistenceChanges(since)
    |-- Always return current header and navigation; sequence indexes changes
    |-- Omitted since returns all records; otherwise merge subsequent changes
    `-- CanvasCheckpointEncoder supplies storage records; internals not supplied

Saved views and generated candidates [O/C/D]
|-- View metadata lives outside undo-restored composition
|   |-- Saved endpoint: finalCheckpointId; baseline: startCheckpointId
|   `-- workingCopies[viewId] records unsaved progress when switching
|-- openCanvasView
|   |-- Same active view: stash only
|   |-- Otherwise choose working copy, falling back to saved endpoint
|   |-- Stash current view; clone target into a new navigation checkpoint
|   `-- Preserve current viewport and remove the target transactionId
|-- Dirty comparison
|   |-- Compare composition, diagram bindings and personal view
|   `-- Ignore viewport and selection fields when comparing personal view
|-- Branch creation and lifetime
|   |-- fork opens one child from the saved endpoint
|   |-- alternatives creates 1..10 uniquely named children without opening
|   |-- keep opens/saves chosen child; archives group siblings and descendants
|   `-- discard can return to parent; delete rejects any view with children
|-- Generation publication
|   |-- startGeneration accepts 1..8 candidates from one pinned endpoint
|   |-- updateGeneration requires matching runId/chatId and a running target
|   |-- Only status finished may supply a proposed history
|   `-- Retain a new candidate endpoint; do not replace the live head
`-- Validation and comparison
    |-- Reject missing checkpoints, invalid working copies and ancestry cycles
    |-- Running generations restrict edits and destructive view operations
    `-- Compare two pinned endpoints directly, including revision dependencies

Cross-canvas transfer preparation [C/O/D]
|-- Prepare against isolated source and destination histories
|   |-- Selection must be nonempty, unique and contain only diagram placements
|   |-- Expand ancestor containers for measurement
|   `-- Normalize selected positions by minimum absolute column/row
|-- Identity remapping
|   |-- Copy always creates new placement/content IDs
|   |-- Move preserves IDs unless destination already uses them
|   |-- A content map clones shared content once for multiple placements
|   `-- Copy sections; rebase highlights, jumps and content-node endpoints
|-- Copy links
|   |-- Copy edges only when both endpoints are selected; validate anchors
|   `-- Source history stays unchanged
|-- Move links and state
|   |-- Validate and convert EVERY source edge to a CanvasJump
|   |   |-- Includes edges with neither endpoint selected
|   |   `-- Assign jump by source placement; source edge array becomes empty
|   |-- Remove selected placements; prune unused source contents/sections
|   `-- Rewrite links to moved targets using sourceAliases
|-- Destination assembly
|   |-- Merge existing content/edges; wrap root if needed; place incoming group
|   `-- Append destination; append source only for move; link transaction IDs
`-- Coordinated undo/redo preparation
    |-- Reject discarded transaction or incompatible applied/redo state
    |-- BOTH heads must match before/after boundaries, even for copy
    `-- Navigate destination and, for move, source; return prepared states

Connection validity and stale anchors [M/D/C]
|-- Public schema
|   |-- Source must be a content-node anchor
|   |-- Target may be a content-node anchor or a box anchor
|   `-- At most 2000 edges; edge IDs must be unique
|-- Endpoint lookup
|   |-- displayNodeId must start with grid: and identify an existing box
|   |-- Content anchor requires a diagram placement
|   `-- contentNodeId belongs to the current content revision
|-- Stale tolerance is deliberate
|   |-- validateConnections allows mismatched revision IDs
|   |-- Same-revision missing node still fails validation
|   |-- edge-create validates both endpoints strictly
|   `-- edge-update permits stale anchors only for unchanged endpoints
|-- reconcileConnections(before, after, edges, nodeIds)
|   |-- Missing placement -> remove incident edge
|   |-- Unchanged revision or already-stale endpoint -> leave anchor alone
|   |-- Explicit mapping to a present node -> update revision and node ID
|   |-- Same ASCII and structure kind -> match line and startColumn
|   `-- Otherwise preserve stale endpoint without guessing
`-- Persistence preserves intent
    |-- Current endpoints encode logical nodeRefs without revisionId
    `-- Unresolvable endpoints retain their original data in unresolvedAnchors

Grid measurement, layout and rendering [D/C]
|-- Coordinate rules
|   |-- Grid positions are zero-based cells; right/bottom edges are exclusive
|   |-- Ancestor offsets + relative position -> absolute origin
|   `-- projectMapping converts one-based source spans into grid bounds
|-- resolveScene measures without mutating input
|   |-- Reject duplicate box IDs and missing referenced contents
|   |-- Printable ASCII + LF -> widest line and line count
|   |-- Expanded bounds include children and optional minimumSize
|   `-- Collapsed box needs collapsedContentId; children are hidden
|       `-- Expanded minimumSize does not reserve collapsed space
|-- layoutScene settles every ancestor of the changed subtree
|   |-- Place anchored child first, then column, row and original index
|   |-- Settled siblings are fixed obstacles; move later siblings right
|   `-- gap adds horizontal separation only where row ranges overlap
|-- composeScene validates and paints
|   |-- Final siblings must not overlap; ancestor containment is allowed
|   |-- Coordinates and final edges cannot exceed 20000
|   |-- Bounding width * height cannot exceed 4000000 cells
|   `-- Optional renderContent callback supplies painted text
`-- hitTest uses resolved bounds
    |-- Reject points on or beyond exclusive right/bottom edges
    `-- Search children before parent; return box ID and local coordinates
